verdict: FAIL_STATIC_ONLY_DO_NOT_AUTHORIZE_ATTEMPT. M1928 is structurally exact and correctly sealed, but the exact M1926 runner cannot pass its pre-attempt authority parser: it indexes top-level p0_count, p1_count, and p2_count in the sealed M1925 review, while M1925 contains those counts only under severity_counts. Independent execution of that parser fragment reproduces KeyError: 'p0_count'. The failure occurs before namespace creation or the license query, so the unique attempt remains unconsumed, but this release must not authorize launch.

findings.title: M1926 authority parser expects absent top-level M1925 count fields

evidence.failure_phase: before namespace freshness check, collision gate, lock, attempt creation, and license query

findings.impact: The exact released runner cannot reach the authorized single VCS attempt. M1927's claim that the M1925 schema/status/reviewer/counts parser was exact is not supported by the frozen source pair.
findings.required_fix: Do not edit any sealed artifact in place. Author an additive fresh runner that validates M1925 severity_counts (or otherwise parses the actual frozen schema), then obtain a new different-author runner review, launch release, and independent release audit.

required_next_gate: Author an additive successor runner that parses the actual sealed M1925 severity_counts object, preserve all M1926 safety and identity gates, obtain a new different-author source review and separately authored launch release plus audit, wait for the same-UID DC gate to clear, and only then consider consuming one fresh attempt.
